title: Choir and Hollow Anew
author: Dominic Sandoval
blurb: Edmund Vasquez, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
